title: 16 Liberator Drive, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Florence James Real Estate proudly presents this impressive 4 bedroom residence, offering a superb blend of lifestyle, comfort and convenience. Perfectly positioned just moments from the bay’s beaches and a short stroll to Saltwater Reserve with its sports fields, BBQ areas and dog park, this home delivers an exceptional coastal inspired lifestyle. Sanctuary Lakes Golf Club and Shopping Centre are only a 5 minute drive or quick local bus ride away, while Williams Landing Train Station is just 10 minutes from your doorstep.
With all the hard work already done, this is a genuine move in ready opportunity—ideal for owner occupiers or investors seeking a property that can be leased out. At the heart of the home is a spacious open plan living, dining and family zone, designed to bring everyone together while still offering room to relax and unwind.

The master bedroom is generously sized and features an ensuite and additional robes, while the modern kitchen overlooks the meals area and includes an impressively sized pantry.

Kitchen Features
• Open plan layout
• 4 burner cooktop
• Rangehood
• Splashback
• Dishwasher

Property Features
• Laminated timber flooring from the entrance through to the family and kitchen areas
• Central heating
• Reverse cycle air conditioning
• Double remote controlled garage
• Low maintenance garden

Families will appreciate the excellent access to quality public and private schools, including the highly regarded Alamanda College located within the area.
This contemporary home offers lifestyle, convenience and comfort—an inspection is essential to truly appreciate its value.

title: 6 Endurance Way, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Krishna M Rathan From Joyous Realty Estates, PointCook Proudly Presenting 6 Endurance Way PointCook

Stylish Family Home | Space, Style & Effortless Living | Heart of Alamanda School Zone

6 Endurance Way, Point Cook

Perfectly positioned in one of Point Cook's most sought-after family-friendly pockets, this beautifully presented home offers the ideal balance of space, comfort, lifestyle, and convenience.

Boasting four generous bedrooms, two bathrooms, multiple living zones, and a double garage with Epoxy, this residence has been thoughtfully designed for modern family living. The spacious master suite features a walk-in robe and private ensuite, while the remaining bedrooms are serviced by a central family bathroom.

At the heart of the property is a stunning open-plan kitchen, dining and living space. The modern kitchen showcases quality appliances, a 20mm stone island bench with breakfast seating, extensive cabinetry and a highly desirable walk-in pantry, making it the perfect hub for entertaining and everyday family life. The adjoining living area offers an inviting space to relax, while the separate lounge or theatre room provides additional flexibility as a media room, children's retreat or home office.

Step outside to a fully covered alfresco, ideal for year-round entertaining, weekend barbecues and outdoor gatherings with family and friends. Out front, an eye-catching aggregate driveway and beautifully landscaped low-maintenance gardens with lush turf and succulents create outstanding street appeal.

Features you’ll love:

• Tiled living areas, floorboards to bedrooms

• Master suite with walk-in robe and ensuite

• Open-plan kitchen with 20mm stone benchtops and Walk in Pantry

• 900mm appliances and dishwasher

• Separate lounge, living and dining

• Ducted heating and evaporative cooling

• Double garage with epoxy flooring

• Alfresco entertaining with fully concreted surrounds

• Low-maintenance front and back yards

• Built-in safety locker

• Laundry with generous storage

Location Highlights

One of the standout features of this home is its exceptional location within the renowned Alamanda School Zone, making it an ideal choice for growing families.

✔ Short walk to Alamanda K-9 College
✔ Easy access to nearby bus stops to Williams landing station, providing convenient public transport connections
✔ Moments from the popular Leap Frog Park, offering playgrounds, open green spaces, walking tracks, and recreational facilities for families to enjoy
✔ Close to sanctuary lakes shopping centre, medical facilities, cafes, childcare, and sporting clubs
✔ Easy access to Point Cook Road and major freeway connections to Melbourne CBD

Please feel free to Contact Krishna M Rathan on M:0413519846
Thank you All from Joyous Realty

ogDescription:
Positioned in the highly sought-after Saratoga Estate of Point Cook, one of Melbourne's fastest-growing and most family-friendly communities, this impressive double-storey residence offers the perfect combination of space, comfort, and lifestyle.

Designed for modern family living, the home features four generous bedrooms, two bathrooms plus an additional powder room, providing ample accommodation for growing families. The oversized master suite is a true retreat, complete with a walk-in robe and private ensuite.

Spacious open-plan kitchen featuring a walk-in pantry (WIP), 900mm stainless steel appliances, providing both style and functionality for everyday family living and entertaining. The kitchen seamlessly connects to the dedicated dining and living areas, creating a warm and inviting space for family gatherings.

Additional features include:
Four spacious bedrooms
Two bathrooms plus separate powder room
Oversized master bedroom with ensuite and walk-in robe
Modern open-plan kitchen with walk-in pantry
900mm stainless steel cooktop and oven
Separate dining and living areas
Double remote garage
Low-maintenance family-friendly allotment

As a resident of Saratoga Estate, you'll enjoy exclusive access to premium estate facilities including a swimming pool, gymnasium, tennis courts, function spaces, and beautifully maintained recreational areas, delivering a resort-style lifestyle right at your doorstep.

Conveniently located with easy access to the Princes Freeway, commuting to Melbourne CBD or Geelong is effortless. You'll also appreciate the close proximity to quality schools, shopping centres, public transport, parklands, and all the amenities that make Point Cook one of Melbourne's most desirable suburbs.

Whether you're upgrading to a larger family home, investing in a thriving growth corridor, or entering the property market for the first time, this is an opportunity not to be missed.

Inspect today and discover the lifestyle you've been searching for.

Elegantly defined by its modern aesthetics, sumptuous proportions and enduring comfort, this double storey residence provides a luxurious family environment, in a prized parkland location.

title: 11 Brookdale Road, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - Property Details
ogDescription:
YPA Point Cook proudly presents this beautifully maintained three-bedroom home, perfectly positioned on a desirable corner allotment in the highly sought-after Saltwater Estate. Designed for effortless family living, this residence combines multiple living zones, a functional floorplan and low-maintenance outdoor spaces, making it an ideal choice for first home buyers, downsizers and investors alike.

As you step inside, you're welcomed by a wide entrance hallway that immediately creates a sense of space and leads you into the heart of the home. Positioned at the front of the property is a generous formal living room, offering the perfect retreat for relaxing, entertaining guests or enjoying a quiet movie night.

The spacious master bedroom is privately located at the front of the home and features a walk-in robe and its own ensuite, creating a peaceful sanctuary away from the remaining bedrooms.

Moving further through the home, you'll find a light-filled open-plan living and dining area that seamlessly connects with the modern kitchen. Designed with both functionality and style in mind, the kitchen boasts quality stainless steel appliances, ample bench space, generous storage and a breakfast bench, making it the perfect hub for everyday family living and entertaining.

The two remaining bedrooms are privately positioned in their own wing and feature built-in robes. They are serviced by a central family bathroom complete with a separate bath, shower and separate toilet, providing added convenience for growing families.

Sliding doors extend the living space outdoors to a private, low-maintenance backyard, creating the ideal setting for weekend barbecues, children to play or simply relaxing with family and friends. The corner position enhances the home's street appeal while allowing for excellent natural light throughout.

Adding even more value, the home is equipped with a **solar panel system**, helping to improve energy efficiency and reduce electricity costs, providing long-term savings and a more sustainable lifestyle.

Property Features:

* Three generous bedrooms
* Master bedroom with walk-in robe and private ensuite
* Built-in robes to the remaining bedrooms
* Two separate living areas
* Spacious open-plan family and dining area
* Modern kitchen with quality stainless steel appliances and breakfast bench
* Central family bathroom with separate toilet
* Split-system heating and cooling
* **Solar panel system for improved energy efficiency and reduced electricity bills**
* Single remote garage with internal access
* Low-maintenance front and rear gardens
* Desirable corner block with excellent street appeal

Location is everything, and this home certainly delivers. In addition to being within walking distance to Saltwater P-9 College, it is also close to Sanctuary Lakes Shopping Centre and located within the catchment for Homestead Senior Secondary College, making it an exceptional choice for families looking to secure a quality home in a highly sought-after pocket of Point Cook.

Don't miss this rare opportunity to make 11 Brookdale Road, Point Cook your new home. For more information or to arrange a private inspection, contact Amit Chahal on 0437 779 139.

Please note: Photo ID is required for all inspections.
